questions.description: 土地仅以农用地、建设用地和未利用地作为直接分类子类。
questions.query:
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
ASK WHERE {
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/AgriculturalLand> rdfs:subClassOf <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/Land> .
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/ConstructionLand> rdfs:subClassOf <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/Land> .
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/UnusedLand> rdfs:subClassOf <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/Land> .
              FILTER NOT EXISTS {
                ?other rdfs:subClassOf <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/Land> .
                FILTER(isIRI(?other) && ?other NOT IN (
                  <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/AgriculturalLand>,
                  <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/ConstructionLand>,
                  <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/UnusedLand>
                ))
              }
            }

questions.description: 地块是与土地互斥的空间单元，并通过可逆函数属性表征土地。
现状和规划状态是土地利用状态的不同且互斥语义轴。
questions.query:
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
ASK WHERE {
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/ObservedLandUseState> rdfs:subClassOf <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/LandUseState>, <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/ObservedState> .
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/PlannedLandUseState> rdfs:subClassOf <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/LandUseState>, <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/PlannedState> .
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/ObservedState> owl:disjointWith <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/PlannedState> .
            }

questions.description: 每次土地利用转换恰有一个地块、源状态和目标状态。
主体和角色互斥，权利由主体持有，主体通过可逆关系承担角色。
questions.query:
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
ASK WHERE {
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/NaturalResourceActor> owl:disjointWith <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/NaturalResourceRole> .
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/property/heldBy> rdfs:range <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/NaturalResourceActor> .
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/property/playsRole> owl:inverseOf <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/property/roleOf> .
            }

questions.description: 用途管制、限制和证据分别进入规则、限制与证据层级。
questions.query:
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
ASK WHERE {
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/UseControlRule> rdfs:subClassOf <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/NaturalResourceRule> .
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/UseRestriction> rdfs:subClassOf <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/NaturalResourceRestriction> .
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/ObservationEvidence> rdfs:subClassOf <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/EvidenceArtifact> .
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/property/governedBy> rdfs:range <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/NaturalResourceRule> .
              <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/property/subjectToRestriction> rdfs:range <https://ontology.gis-data-agent.local/natural-resource/one-map/class/NaturalResourceRestriction> .
            }

questions.description: 每个策划领域类都具有审定处置和来源匹配或显式证据缺口。
应用功能和 EA 包不进入自然资源领域 OWL 类层次。
